strings.zh: 欢迎光临！{SCROLL}这里使用{VAR:0132:0}ＢＰ{NEWLINE}可以购买３张刮奖卡哦！{SCROLL}在卡片隐藏着精灵的标记哦。{SCROLL}刮开３次后{NEWLINE}如果发现３个同样标记,{CLEAR}就可以得到树果和奖品哦！{SCROLL}不管是哪个百变怪标记{NEWLINE}精灵都可以变身！{SCROLL}请好好收集标记吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Welcome!{NEWLINE}Would you like some Scratch-Off Cards?{SCROLL}You may buy three Scratch-Off Cards{NEWLINE}for {VAR:0132:0} BP.{SCROLL}Hidden on each Scratch-Off Card are{NEWLINE}icons of Pokémon.{SCROLL}You may scratch the obscuring film off{NEWLINE}a card three times.{SCROLL}If the same icon appears three times,{NEWLINE}you will win a prize, like a Berry.{SCROLL}Also, Ditto’s icon can transform into{NEWLINE}any other Pokémon.{SCROLL}Good luck matching Pokémon icons!{SCROLL}
